title: Cop’s Wife Thinks She’s Entitled To Drive Drunk
description:
This rich woman is the epitome of entitlement—you’ll soon see why. He is her husband, and before they stopped their vehicles, he had shown the officer his middle fingers. While the officer was occupied with the paperwork, she managed to free herself from the cuffs. It seemed like all of her importance relied on the fact that her husband was a cop. One of the officers found a loaded gun in the woman’s Jeep. She was charged with assault and DUI.
